long_biography.plain_text:
Printing was Alberto Peruzzo's first business platform. In 1989, at 24, he started a small typography operation near Padua that grew into Peruzzo Industrie Grafiche, combining prepress, offset and digital printing, binding and logistics. The company became one part of Proinvest Holding, which brought together graphic production and publishing with finance and energy.

Energy developed into his clearest current operating role. Peruzzo founded Argos in 2003 and remains its sole director, guiding an integrated electricity and natural-gas supplier with a regional retail network in northern Italy. His activity beyond commerce has an institutional home in the Alberto Peruzzo Foundation, created to promote contemporary art and preserve historic assets. Its restoration of Padua's former church of Sant'Agnese joined his long-standing art collecting to a public cultural space.

uncertainties.detail: At least three public figures share the exact name: this younger Padua entrepreneur, a Milan publisher born in 1934, and an RMIT quantum-photonics professor. The younger entrepreneur is resolved through the immutable ownership anchor and independent Nuova Venezia reporting, then corroborated by Padua company and foundation records.

The elder Milan publisher's 1960s publishing and television record is not assigned to this subject. The younger Peruzzo's documented publishing activity sits within his own Padua graphic-production and Proinvest context. No family relationship between the two exact-name businessmen is inferred without reliable evidence.

Official company history says Peruzzo was 24 when he founded the printing business in 1989, and Nuova Venezia says he was 49 in January 2014. Those facts narrow birth to approximately 1964 or 1965 but do not establish a unique date, so no birth year, month or day is proposed.

Private-company financial disclosure is insufficient to allocate personal wealth precisely among printing, energy, publishing and finance. Manufacturing is the earliest documented platform, while energy is the clearest current operating role; neither classification treats company revenue or assets as personal property.

Peruzzo is described as self-made and founded both documented operating platforms. Because family backing and starting capital are not fully disclosed, the broad Self-made category is used instead of an independent or advantaged subtype.

The official Argos site is proposed as the relevant company website. The prominent Italian Wikipedia result belongs to the elder publisher and is excluded. No exact personal LinkedIn, Instagram or personal website was verified.

Vessel facts were used only for identity disambiguation and do not appear in either biography. Politics, controversy, allegations, legal matters, private-family material, personal valuations and transient company metrics are also excluded.
